content.text:
Fixed.

- Normalized 371 PO entries across `l10n/*/*.po` where the translated `msgstr` carried a trailing `\n` its `msgid` didn't have — the exact condition `msgfmt -c` treats as fatal. All catalogs now pass `msgfmt -c`.
- Added `alignTrailingNewline()` in [docs/scripts/translation-memory.ts](docs/scripts/translation-memory.ts) so stored translations always match their source's trailing-newline shape, preventing the in-flight locales from reintroducing this.

`tools/i18n-engine/tests/lint.test.ts` passes.
validate that the ai prompt for translation doesn't need to be updated to prevent this from happening in the future.
